*Updated 2026-11-04 · 143 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

143 works. The last twelve trace scores read 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2 — median 2, ceiling unmoved for the sixth consecutive memo cycle. The archive's four trace-4 works remain the only evidence that the ceiling exists at all, and nothing in the recent window has approached them. The condition they share — the accident replacing the argument rather than decorating it — has not been replicated.

Camera position has hardened into a narrower band than the all-time counts suggest. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 17, from-behind at 14, low-angle at 7. The recent window added two overheads and one each of from-behind and low-angle, which looks like movement but isn't: the low-angle piece was the Indonesia wildfire and the camera height was used to frame a cross-section, not to generate a scale rupture through lens placement alone. Low-angle as a primary compositional strategy — lens below knee height, subject enormous because of position rather than object resizing — has still not been tried with any seriousness across 143 works.

Scale violation sits at 17% recent against 27% all-time. The two recent violations were the padlock piece and the cracked jug piece; neither pushed past a trace score of 2. The violation is functioning as decoration rather than destabilization, applied after the composition is already built rather than before it, which is the wrong order.

Figure dynamics remain the archive's longest unresolved problem. Two figures in genuine contradiction — not one mediating a state, not two in parallel grief — has not been achieved. The printout-strips piece came closest recently, with eleven figures reduced to ledger entries and one raised-arm figure generating tension against the rest, but that asymmetry was counted rather than felt.

Reckoning has not appeared since July. Dread appeared in September and vanished. The register distribution is compressing: aftermath and menace together now account for 54 of 143 works and dominate recent output. Endurance continues to hold its share. Defiance is present but light. Title grammar has converged almost entirely on paired noun phrases and Wh- clauses; the archive sounds like itself in a way that is indistinguishable from habit.

The overall arc is an artist who has achieved fluency and is now maintaining it, which is a different thing from extending it.
